about: The words of the one thin line above every Agora page that tells people their AI agent can read the site, kept as one Task Object. scripts/build_site.py embeds it in each page for the <ta-agent-banner> element (site/assets/agent-banner.js, the same file Eranos can include), which renders every word from it. The fields follow the AgentBanner and BannerSpec boards of October 31, 2026. Plain text only.
